title: Odyssey victory requires the Mechhive conclusion
summary: Flight is progression, not victory; the Mechhive quest leads to the credits ending.
body: The wiki describes inspecting an installed grav engine to begin The Gravship quest, then completing seven subquests to reveal the Mechhive. Reaching it requires a gravship with a signal jammer. Three cerebrex stabilizers protect the core; destroying them brings immediate mechanoid attacks. The final core interaction offers endings that roll credits. Treat this as route research: inspect current quest prerequisites, prepare for orbital conditions and combat, and verify the actual credits before claiming victory. A pilot console or a successful launch is not the ending.

sources.supports: Quest progression, access requirements, stabilizers and credits outcomes
sources.authority: Community wiki; runtime quest UI remains authority

applicability.mod_caveat: Quest mods and game updates may change requirements.

review: Read source; narrow paraphrase, not a claim that this colony has completed any prerequisite.
